name: Draft social posts from a seed
tagline: Give me a customer win or product update; I'll draft 3 versions (long LinkedIn / short LinkedIn / Twitter) and drop them in Slack.
description: Drafts only — never auto-publishes. You review and post. The drafts stick to your facts; I don't make up customer names, metrics, or quotes.

seed.description: The angle / news / story you want to post about

test_cases.name: customer win seed

input.seed: A bookkeeping firm using our platform processed 200 invoices this month with zero errors and saved 18 hours.

test_cases.rubric: Three variants posted to Slack: long LinkedIn (100–180 words), short LinkedIn (40–80), Twitter (≤240). Uses the metric in the seed faithfully, no invented customer name.

test_cases.name: thin seed
test_cases.rubric: Three variants. Does NOT invent revenue, churn, ARR, or any specific number not in the seed.

test_cases.name: playful tone request

input.seed: Our team just shipped batch processing.

test_cases.rubric: Three variants in a slightly more casual register but still no emojis (unless seed implies them) and no inflated claims.
